_comment: An address is recorded here ONLY after gen_getContractSchema (and get_config) confirm it is live. An empty address means not deployed, and the frontend fails closed on it. Every superseded address is kept with the reason it was replaced.

superseded.reason: Internal docstring and comment corrected: SSRF rules are enforced when the URL list is frozen; validators re-apply normalization and length rules at fetch. No executable behavior changed.

Superseded during the accepted-build audit: _judge now fetches with gl.nondet.web.get and normalizes on the explicit HTTP status, so a non-200 page can never be read as evidence. The previous build called web.render(mode='text') and treated any successful return as HTTP 200.
